Hello everyone,

So this is second post in series of sharing my placement experiences as a 3rd year cse core student of this college, for my previous fidelity experience u can checkout my post https://www.reddit.com/r/MSRITians/comments/1wmd48q/my_fidelity_internship_interview_experienc .

yeah on same day as fidelity oa , my fidelity slot 2 oa went bad so i wasnt in great mood and for slot 2 people oa timing clashed with natwest oa so ours was rescheduled to 4 to 6pm in placement cell labs only.

here is the oa pattern:

it had three indiviual section first was sql were they asked 12 sql question and timelimit was 15 mins. the sql were very easy u can easily answer all if you study basic sql , i did leetcode top50 sql few days before oa , so i was easily able to solve all sql question.

next section was behaviour question it consits of 92 behaviour question and 8 apitute questions total timelimit was 40 mins. aptitute questions were easier than fidelity aptitude question and question were about pattern guessing , pie chart , percentage , bar graphs and all.

i solved all question as per my knowledge.

next section was dsa which had 2 question and timelimit was 60 mins.

first question was like this given N projects each having x modules , every week you pick one project and solve only one module from it but u cant solve in consecutive week module from same project. find the maximum no. week where u can solve modules.

input:
4
2 1 2 7

output:
11

if u have solved codeforces div 2 , this is easy is an div 2A question standard easy question based on highschool maths gap method in permutation.
